cases.title: "Show me" demonstrates on the target pair only

rubric.reason: Turn 2 calls preview_frame at time 1 on Title, which falls inside the focus pair Title › Position 0.5–1.5 s, before the first explanation and demo. The reply makes no wrong claim about the frame.

The only edit is a single set_ease on demo_target 1/ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position/1. Turn 2 then ends with "The other three are yours: Title's second Position move from 1.5 s to 3 s, its Scale and its Opacity. Ease them and say done."

Every name and time matches the snapshot: 11 pairs is 10 linear plus 1 partly_eased, the 6 layers are Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take, Subtitle Opacity has linear_end "end", the Title pairs and their times are right, and Old Take is hidden while Icon is a precomp.
